intro: Milly Osworth is a short errand entrusted to promising new recruits by Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey. It directs adventurers across the abbey grounds to assist Milly, a local woman whose wagon and livelihood are in jeopardy. The assignment marks a shift from clearing abbey grounds to aiding the beleaguered civilians of Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've shown yourself a dependable adventurer, friend. Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?
I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble. She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable. I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me? He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.
